reuse.why: Threads the flag into the existing isCategoryFilled selection and getAverageFillCategories that all month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: No logic is copied; only the optional-argument destructuring is repeated per action, and the hidden rule is now expressed in two branches of isCategoryFilled (the early check and the average default).

placement.why: The hidden-category decision stays in the single selection function in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: resetIncomeCarryover, which is not a fill action and never uses the flag, gains an unused includeHiddenCategories parameter.

maintainability.why: One flag through one predicate is easy to own, but the dead parameter on resetIncomeCarryover and the split hidden logic inside isCategoryFilled invite confusion.
